CE-NF1A-ADOPT.title: Adopt preserved NF1 work and switch the execution frontier
CE-NF1A-ADOPT.objective: Verify both successor imports; preserve and map existing work, reconcile expired NF1 authority, and retire only superseded unfinished old NF1 records. Establish the usable build/gate/delegation bindings without rebuilding tooling.
CE-NF1A-ADOPT.rationale: This is a recovery-and-handoff outcome, not a repeat architectural audit. Completed work is an input, not work to redo.

CE-NF1A-CONTROL.title: Coordinate and close the accepted local program
CE-NF1A-CONTROL.objective: Hold the ordinary local coordinator seat, choose and adapt execution, keep producer delivery and qualification moving, and finish only after local RELEASE.
CE-NF1A-CONTROL.rationale: A claimable coordinator must not depend at claim time on the work it coordinates. Its final gate, not its start prerequisite, requires release.

CE-NF1A-CORE.title: Deliver the general-width linked numerical core
CE-NF1A-CORE.objective: Reuse preserved B/P/V/N implementation and relevant D01/T evidence, coordinate donor ownership, and complete general-width FP32 primitives, prepared execution, independent values and a real separately linked CPU/CUDA consumer.
CE-NF1A-CORE.rationale: The paused system already has the right execution/value owners. Finish and expose them rather than introduce another runner or tensor framework.

CE-NF1A-MECHANISMS.title: Deliver reusable nonlinear indexed mechanisms
CE-NF1A-MECHANISMS.objective: Complete the preserved H work as real CPU/CUDA n-ary operations, inspectable composition and registered custom blocks with explicit output and predicate behavior.
CE-NF1A-MECHANISMS.rationale: Biological mechanism identity must survive numerical grouping. Pairwise algebra alone cannot express the intended nonlinear joint mechanisms.

CE-NF1A-SUPPORT.title: Deliver exact and qualified approximate support behavior
CE-NF1A-SUPPORT.objective: Implement persistent activity, exact compact-active execution, independent activity generations, epoch replacement and honest derivative/approximation support.
CE-NF1A-SUPPORT.rationale: Masking, zero values, structural absence and small response are different facts; compaction is a required alternative, not a required performance winner.

CE-NF1A-RESPONSE.title: Deliver native directional response
CE-NF1A-RESPONSE.objective: Compose state/parameter JVP/VJP and supported second directions through the real numerical program with correct primal lifetime, precision, branch and invalidation semantics.
CE-NF1A-RESPONSE.rationale: Differentiate the implemented mathematical object. A generation stamp is not a historical snapshot, and an unavailable derivative is not zero.

CE-NF1A-QUALIFY.title: Integrate continuously and publish consumer-ready Cellerator
CE-NF1A-QUALIFY.objective: Integrate CORE first and later producer commits as they arrive, keep central build hooks usable, independently qualify the combined stack and evaluate full-program performance. Publish the pinned consumer-ready receipt.
CE-NF1A-QUALIFY.rationale: This integration owner starts after CORE, not after all producers. Final completion requires them; early integration does not. Optimization implementation is conditional on evidence.

CE-NF1A-RELEASE.title: Verify real-consumer acceptance and close Cellerator
CE-NF1A-RELEASE.objective: Verify GlassHelix ACCEPT and its exact Cellerator source, reconcile published main and preserved work, and issue the final Cellerator receipt without gratuitously rerunning unchanged qualification.
CE-NF1A-RELEASE.rationale: Consumer-ready and consumer-accepted are different boundaries. Final verification must not create a mutual-final dependency.

GH-NF1A-ADOPT.title: Adopt preserved NF1 work and switch the execution frontier
GH-NF1A-ADOPT.objective: Verify both successor imports; preserve completed contracts and partial S01 source; reconcile stale NF1 authority and retire only superseded unfinished legacy records. Bind actual runtime and gate commands.
GH-NF1A-ADOPT.rationale: This changes execution guidance, not scientific scope or the history of successful work.

GH-NF1A-CONTROL.title: Coordinate and close the accepted local program
GH-NF1A-CONTROL.objective: Serve as the strategic root and ordinary GlassHelix coordinator, delegate bounded work intelligently, coordinate the Cellerator seat and finish only after local RELEASE.
GH-NF1A-CONTROL.rationale: Preserve global reasoning at the root without turning it into an expensive scheduler of procedural microtasks.

GH-NF1A-SYSTEM.title: Deliver usable native systems and deterministic evolution
GH-NF1A-SYSTEM.objective: Finish native linking and preserved S01 assembly, lower supplied n-ary systems to Cellerator, bind independent instances and implement maps, forcing, RK4, resident rollout and bounded primal checkpoints.
GH-NF1A-SYSTEM.rationale: This is the first usable consumer, not a final learner. Preserve scientific meaning above the existing numerical engine; eliminate test-only dependency recompilation in production.

GH-NF1A-OBSERVE.title: Deliver observation and finite-candidate evidence updates
GH-NF1A-OBSERVE.objective: Implement distinct observation records and simple declared likelihoods, then propagate and reweight supplied finite candidates without losing joint identity or reporter correlations.
GH-NF1A-OBSERVE.rationale: What determines the answer and what helps infer that determining state need not be the same information. This must remain executable, not merely documented.

GH-NF1A-ANALYZE.title: Deliver response, local ambiguity and supplied-reduction instruments
GH-NF1A-ANALYZE.objective: Compose requested observation/rollout derivatives, scaled local sensitivity/null diagnostics, aligned alternative comparison and supplied-reduction/error checks.
GH-NF1A-ANALYZE.rationale: These are instruments over supplied models: local numerical evidence is not global identification, molecular discovery or universal minimal-state inference.

GH-NF1A-ACCESS.title: Deliver thin Python access, inspection and portable replay
GH-NF1A-ACCESS.objective: Expose the same native implementation in Python, with correct array and asynchronous ownership, capability/failure inspection, logical replay artifacts and useful examples.
GH-NF1A-ACCESS.rationale: Bind one library rather than duplicate its mathematics; replay logical inputs, not ephemeral pointers or opaque generations.

GH-NF1A-ACCEPT.title: Integrate continuously and qualify the real consumer
GH-NF1A-ACCEPT.objective: Integrate SYSTEM first and other outcomes as available, run independent mathematical and lifetime counterexamples, native/Python/replay acceptance and bounded whole-workload measurements on the qualified Cellerator source.
GH-NF1A-ACCEPT.rationale: The integrator may work before CE final readiness; only this final consumer acceptance waits for CE QUALIFY. Do not block early development on final receipts.

GH-NF1A-RELEASE.title: Verify the final source pair and close GlassHelix
GH-NF1A-RELEASE.objective: Consume CE RELEASE, verify both published source revisions and all preservation dispositions, issue the final paired receipt and allow only owned verified-merged cleanup.
GH-NF1A-RELEASE.rationale: This is a source/evidence reconciliation, not another unconditional test campaign or the start of a biological experiment.
